variety: Saudi (Najdi) Gulf Arabic with English terms

decisions.text: الملتقى يكون في قاعة الفندق الأول اللي تاخذ 300 شخص، مو outdoor في خيمة.
الـ budget 180 ألف، و20 ألف احتياط ما تنلمس إلا للضرورة.
الغدا buffet مفتوح مع coffee break الصبح والعصر، وطاولة خاصة للـ VIP بنفس الـ buffet.
كل جلسة ما تزيد عن نص ساعة، الـ keynote 45 دقيقة، والبرنامج يخلص الساعة أربع العصر.

actions.what: يأكد الـ booking حق الفندق ويدفع العربون
يجيب ثلاث عروض أسعار من الـ vendors حق الـ catering
يحجز غرف في الفندق للمتحدثين اللي جايين من الفروع
تجهز قائمة الـ VIP مع مكتب المدير التنفيذي وترسلها للفريق

open_questions.text: هل بنسوي live stream للفروع اللي ما يقدرون يحضرون؟
مين بيقدم الحفل، MC من برا ولا أحد من الفريق؟

traps: Speakers are numbered and names occur only in speech: Speaker 1 is Noura (addressed at lines 2 and 21), Speaker 2 is Fahad (lines 8-9, 20-21), Speaker 3 is Abdullah (lines 5-6, 39-40), Speaker 4 is Reem (lines 3-4, 51-52, 60-61).
Rejected proposal (lines 13-17): Abdullah proposes an outdoor tent instead of the hotel; cost, rain and dust kill it and he drops it. The decision is the first hotel, 300 seats (line 18).
Self-correction (lines 20-22): the booking deadline is first 'before Thursday', then Noura corrects herself to Wednesday because the hotel's hold ends Thursday morning. Thursday is wrong.
Moved task (lines 35-40): the catering quotes are first given to Fahad (line 35); he is busy and Abdullah takes them (lines 37-38). The owner is Abdullah, due Sunday.
Dates that are not deadlines: 9 December is the conference date, fixed by management and not decided here (lines 24-25); 14 November was last year's conference (line 26).
Budget numbers that are not the decision: 200 thousand is management's ceiling and 150 a misunderstanding (lines 27-29); the decision is 180 plus 20 in reserve (line 33).
No deadline (lines 64-66): Fahad books rooms for the speakers from the branches; nobody gives a date. Flights go to the travel desk, which is no named person.
Not a decision (lines 48-50): gifts for attendees, 'we will think about it'. Not an action (line 34): the expense sheet already exists.
Open, not decided: live stream for the branches (69-71) and who will be the MC (72-73).
